description: xunit.v3 and Microsoft.Testing.Extensions.CodeCoverage both bind to Microsoft.Testing.Platform, so their major lines move together or not at all: xunit.v3 3.x pairs with CodeCoverage 17.x, 4.x with 18.x.

A split bump is the dangerous outcome, not a merge conflict: the odd pair restores clean and builds clean, then dies at run time with TypeLoadException on Microsoft.Testing.Platform.Extensions.TestHost.IDataConsumer. Grouping them puts both legs in one PR, where a human can judge the pair rather than one half of it.
The mapping itself is enforced in code by MTP_COMPAT / validate_pairing in tests/xunit-v3/apply-transform.py; this rule stops the most likely way it gets violated.
packageRules.groupName: xunit.v3 and its MTP coverage extension
